note: Chapter 1 plays three kicks live: Zahovič is saved on 'saves from', Carboni's shot is tipped on 'fingertips' and hits the bar on 'onto the bar', Pellegrino runs on 'steps up' and is saved on 'saved'; leave a short breath after 'steps up...'. Chapter 2 is the slow replay of the Pellegrino save ('keeps it out'). Read 'Zahovič' as ZA-ho-vich, 'Carboni' car-BO-nee, 'Pellegrino' pel-eh-GREE-no.

chapters.label: Penalties, live
chapters.text: Milan, 2001. The Champions League final goes to penalties. Oliver Kahn guesses right and saves from Zahovič. Carboni shoots, and Kahn's fingertips push it onto the bar. Then Pellegrino steps up... saved! Bayern win!

chapters.label: The winning save
chapters.text: Watch the winning save again, slowly. Kahn stands tall and still. He waits for the kick, guesses correctly, dives and keeps it out. Bayern are champions of Europe!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn, keepers. Even when a penalty goes in, stay strong and confident. Forget the last kick, and face one penalty at a time.
